clue.text: Drugs quietly damage expert near New York city limits (both East and West)

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical marking for quietly
to harm is to damage
an ace is an expert
Utica is a city in upstate New York

indicators.note: the limits on the east and west of a word are its right and left ends, so only those two outside letters are kept

parts.note: the first and last letters of the word limits

explanation.surface: Drug dealing quietly harms a specialist living near the edges of a New York city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'City limits' reads as one phrase, but 'limits' is split off: its own two ends supply the closing letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Pharmaceuticals are medicinal drugs, the products of the pharmacy industry.

clue.text: Infestation said to cover circular area for 4

indicators.note: said means spoken, and it covers both the following words, so the pair is judged by ear

parts.note: a plague of insects is an infestation
round means circular

explanation.surface: A pest outbreak spreads over a circular patch set aside for the youngsters.
explanation.walkthrough: Spoken quickly, 'plague round' runs together to sound like the answer. The 4 refers to 4-down, CHILDREN.
explanation.definitionFit: A playground is an outdoor space where children play.

clue.text: On the way back, help pass around fruit

indicators.note: going on the way back means travelling in the opposite direction, so the letters are read right to left
the words sit around the target, which lies inside them across the gap

parts.note: letters running from inside the first word into the start of the second

explanation.surface: Coming home, someone asks for help passing the fruit bowl around.
explanation.definitionFit: The apple is a common orchard fruit.

clue.text: Civil servant with a redundant-sounding job

parts.note: surface reading: a government employee, such as a postal worker
setter's reading: the job title, said out loud, seems to call a man male twice over

explanation.walkthrough: The postal worker's title sounds like 'male man', a phrase that repeats itself.
explanation.definitionFit: A US postal carrier is a government employee, so a letter carrier counts as a civil servant.

clue.text: Kids in South American country largely misdirected geek

indicators.note: largely means mostly but not wholly, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: Chile is a country in South America

indicators.note: something misdirected is sent the wrong way, so these letters are jumbled

parts.note: a nerd is a geek

explanation.surface: Children in a South American country are mostly led astray by a nerdy type.
explanation.definitionFit: Kids is the everyday informal word for children.

clue.text: Got high from a bit of uncensored writing

indicators.note: a bit of a word is just a small part, here its opening letter

parts.note: the first letter of uncensored
prose is ordinary writing

explanation.surface: Someone became intoxicated from reading a passage of explicit material.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Got high' suggests drugs; here it simply means rose.
explanation.definitionFit: Uprose is an old literary past tense of uprise, meaning rose upward or ascended.

clue.text: Ape is the first companion hiding that thing

indicators.note: the first of a word is its opening letter, so only that one is kept

parts.note: the first letter of is

indicators.note: a thing that hides another keeps it out of sight inside itself

parts.note: a mate is a companion
it is the pronoun for a thing

explanation.surface: A gorilla is the first friend to cover up an object.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ape' is the verb, not the animal.
explanation.definitionFit: To ape someone is to copy their manner, which is the meaning of imitate.

clue.text: Compulsion to use a mathematical operation, getting an average grade

indicators.note: the operation is getting a grade the way a body gets an implant, taking it inside

parts.note: addition is one of the four arithmetic operations
C is a middling grade on an A to F scale

explanation.surface: A student is driven to do sums but still only earns a middling mark.
explanation.walkthrough: The grade is slipped into the operation rather than tacked onto the end.
explanation.definitionFit: An addiction is a habit one feels compelled to repeat, so it is a compulsion.

clue.text: Time to pray for an erotic message

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the canonical hour of prayer at midday
second meaning: a sexually explicit text sent by phone

explanation.surface: It's prayer time, and someone uses it to send a racy text.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both the sixth of the monastic daily offices and modern slang for a racy phone text.

clue.text: Dislodged a firm pile to get equipment for a band

indicators.note: something dislodged is knocked out of place, so these letters are moved into a new order

parts.note: the fodder, taken letter for letter

explanation.surface: Someone shifts a company's heap of stuff to find gear for their band.
explanation.definitionFit: An amplifier is a piece of kit that boosts a band's instruments to concert volume.

clue.text: George Bush is out of cleaning product for table

indicators.note: when someone is out of a thing they are no longer in it, so that letter leaves the word

parts.note: Windex is a well-known American glass cleaner
George W. Bush is widely known by his middle initial, W ('Dubya')

explanation.surface: The former president has run out of a spray for cleaning the table.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove the W from WINDEX to leave INDEX.
explanation.definitionFit: An index is a table of references, as at the back of a book, so the two words are synonyms there.

clue.text: Single amethyst provides sparkle

indicators.note: the run of words provides the letters itself, as they sit inside the phrase

parts.note: found running across the end of the first word and the start of the second

explanation.surface: One purple gemstone is enough to give a piece some shine.
explanation.definitionFit: A gleam is a brief flash of light, the same thing as a sparkle.

clue.text: Laurel interrupts game of chance, resulting in separation

indicators.note: something that interrupts breaks into the middle of another thing, so one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: dice is a game of chance
Stan Laurel, of the comedy double act Laurel and Hardy

explanation.surface: A laurel wreath gets in the way of a gambling game and drives people apart.
explanation.walkthrough: Laurel is not the plant but the comedian Stan Laurel.
explanation.definitionFit: Distance is the amount of separation between two things or people.

clue.text: Oh! Nice broadcast before musical becomes chaotic

indicators.note: to broadcast is to scatter widely, as seed is sown, so these letters are scattered

parts.note: the fodder, taken letter for letter
Rent is Jonathan Larson's Broadway rock musical

explanation.surface: A pleasant radio slot ahead of a show turns into a mess.
explanation.definitionFit: Something incoherent lacks order or sense, so it is muddled and chaotic.

clue.text: Lawbreaker to kill Terminator

parts.note: to off someone is slang for to kill them
an ender is something that terminates

explanation.surface: A criminal sets out to kill the cyborg from the Terminator films.
explanation.definitionFit: An offender is a person who commits an offence, someone who breaks the law.

clue.text: Plump fish losing roe, to begin with, and gaining offspring

parts.note: plump means fat

indicators.note: losing something means it goes missing, so a letter drops out
to begin with points to the opening letter of the word before it, which is the one lost

parts.note: the herring is a common food fish
the opening letter of roe, the one taken away

explanation.surface: A chubby fish that has shed its eggs is producing young.
explanation.walkthrough: HERRING has two Rs; dropping one leaves FAT + HERING.
explanation.definitionFit: Fathering is siring children, which is how a man comes to have offspring.

clue.text: Sketch is badly singed

indicators.note: something done badly is botched, so these letters come out in the wrong order

parts.note: the fodder, taken letter for letter

explanation.surface: A drawing has been scorched in a fire.
explanation.definitionFit: A design is a drawing or plan, much the same as a sketch.

clue.text: Paramour takes ecstasy while in a rehab program — it's soothing

indicators.note: taking something in means holding it inside, so a letter goes into the middle

parts.note: AA, Alcoholics Anonymous, runs a recovery programme

indicators.note: being in something means sitting within it, so this group goes inside the outer pair

parts.note: a paramour is a lover
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A lover in recovery slips back onto ecstasy, finding it calming.
explanation.definitionFit: Aloe vera gel is used as a balm for burns and dry skin, a classic soothing remedy.

clue.text: Particle with zero charge? There's an idea

parts.note: a particle carrying no charge is not one of the charged kind
an ion is an electrically charged particle

explanation.surface: A physicist proposes a neutral particle and is pleased with the thought.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the joke: a particle with zero charge is, by definition, NOT an ION.
explanation.definitionFit: A notion is a thought or concept, the same as an idea.

clue.text: Bizarre opera in the outdoors

indicators.note: bizarre means strange or freakish, so these letters end up in an odd order

parts.note: the fodder, taken letter for letter

explanation.surface: A strange opera is being staged outside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the outdoors' looks like a phrase, but 'in' belongs to the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Open-air describes things happening outside, the same idea as outdoors.

clue.text: Bird is on fire on disc

parts.note: something on fire is flaming
the letter O is disc-shaped

explanation.surface: A bird has caught fire on a record or a plate.
explanation.walkthrough: The first 'on' is part of 'on fire'; the second just places the piece in front of the disc.
explanation.definitionFit: The flamingo is a tall pink wading bird.

clue.text: Bee beneath mother's tree

indicators.note: in a down entry, whatever sits beneath comes lower, so the bee is placed after the mother

parts.note: ma is mother; the 's is read as 'has' and links
a drone is a male bee

explanation.surface: A bee is buzzing below Mum's tree.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'beneath' puts the bee below the mother, so it comes second.
explanation.definitionFit: The madrone is a red-barked evergreen of western North America, also called the madrona.

clue.text: A catchphrase is almost a way to catch someone

indicators.note: almost means nearly but not quite, so the last letter is cut

parts.note: a mantrap is a trap set to catch people

explanation.surface: A snappy slogan is nearly enough to trap someone.
explanation.definitionFit: A mantra is a phrase or slogan repeated over and over, like a catchphrase.

clue.text: Emissary from the French at the door

parts.note: de is French for from
le is a French word for the
the gate is the money taken at the door of an event

explanation.surface: An envoy from France has turned up on the doorstep.
explanation.walkthrough: 'French' covers both 'from' and 'the', giving two French words in a row.
explanation.definitionFit: A delegate is a person sent to represent others, which is what an emissary is.

clue.text: Prodded peacenik to accept end of war

indicators.note: accepting something means taking it in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a dove is a person who favours peace

indicators.note: the end of a word is its final letter, so only that one is kept

parts.note: the last letter of war

explanation.surface: Someone nudged a pacifist into agreeing that the fighting must stop.
explanation.definitionFit: To drive cattle is to urge them forward, so drove is another word for prodded along.

clue.text: At first, orchids are green

indicators.note: at first means at the very start, so only the opening letter is kept

parts.note: the first letter of orchids
to be is to exist or live, so 'are' can stand for 'live'

explanation.surface: Orchids start out with green colouring.
explanation.definitionFit: Olive is a dull yellowish shade of green, the colour of unripe olives.

clue.text: That woman's a goddess

parts.note: her is the possessive pronoun for that woman
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone points out a woman and calls her divine.
explanation.definitionFit: Hera is the queen of the Greek gods, wife of Zeus.

clue.text: Musical résumé online?

parts.note: e- is the prefix for electronic or online things, as in email
a vita (curriculum vitae) is an academic résumé

explanation.surface: A performer's CV for a stage show is posted on the internet.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer reads as an online version of a vita: e-vita.
explanation.definitionFit: Evita is the Andrew Lloyd Webber and Tim Rice stage musical about Eva Perón.

clue.text: Sting set in motion by them!

definitions.text: Sting set in motion by them!

parts.words: Sting set in motion by them!
parts.note: surface reading: an undercover sting operation, launched by law enforcement officers
setter's reading: the singer Sting, whose career was launched by the band he fronted

explanation.walkthrough: Both readings point to one name: the force that runs sting operations and the rock band that made the singer famous.
explanation.definitionFit: The rock trio formed in London in 1977 made Sting a star, and police forces carry out sting operations.

clue.text: Soldier, possibly capturing European-era soldiers — that's what it takes to stay in control

definitions.text: what it takes to stay in control

indicators.note: a captor holds its prisoner inside, so the following pieces sit within the first

parts.note: a soldier is one caste of ant, hence 'possibly'
a German is a European
an age is an era
men is a common word for soldiers, as in officers and men

explanation.surface: A soldier rounds up troops from an earlier European period, as needed to stay in charge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Soldier' looks like the definition, but with 'possibly' it is an insect.
explanation.definitionFit: Anger management is therapy for keeping one's temper in check, so it is the skill needed to keep control of oneself.
